dataset: Deterministic 100k-line Rust file; 1,000 typed chars; 10 s smooth scroll; 100 window resizes
success_threshold: Instrumentation overhead <=2%; after refactor p95 and p99 latency <= baseline*1.05 and skipped frames do not increase
result: Seven CPU-pinned release-fast runs: candidate/default median overhead <=1.902%; feature-on candidate/baseline p95/p99 ratios are 1.030/1.034 typing, 0.999/0.995 scroll, and 1.008/1.033 resize; exact input-to-present p50/p95/p99 are 2.913/3.057/3.299 ms; 0 skipped/dropped
notes: Baseline product revision 567ff2f4 with measurement-only runner and printable-input scope; raw logs and summary are in .tmp/gpui-refactor/phase-1/editor-workload-*-v3-*.log and editor-workload-summary.txt.

workload: Cached and dirty view render cost
dataset: Editor, workspace tabs, command palette, settings; unchanged frame plus single-entity update
metric: request_layout, prepaint, paint, scene replay duration and counts
success_threshold: Unchanged cached frame reuses the same or more view ranges; dirty single-entity p95 total phase cost <= baseline*1.05
result: Production Editor phase operation counts are unchanged and all median phase-time ratios are <=1.0064; paired product-view p95 ratios are 1.000898/1.001593 for workspace tabs cached/dirty, 1.017539/0.990516 for Settings cached/dirty, and 1.024921 for command palette; operation and cache replay counts are identical
notes: Seven CPU-pinned processes per revision and workload against 567ff2f4; raw logs and summary are in .tmp/gpui-refactor/phase-1/exp002-*.log and exp002-product-summary.txt.

dataset: Fixed scene corpus: text/emoji/SVG/images/clips/shadows/paths at 1x and 2x
metric: Pixel diff, render completion, GPU adapter availability, wall time
success_threshold: Linux and Windows software/hardware adapters render every scene; <=0.5% differing pixels after per-platform approved baselines; no hangs in 100 runs
result: Linux RADV and llvmpipe each render the clipped primitive/atlas corpus 100 times at 1x and 2x; all four pre/post-refactor image hashes are identical; Windows runtime not run
notes: Cross-adapter 2x differences are not a regression baseline and are retained as an INVALID SAMPLE; Windows exact runbook remains required.

workload: Extract narrow platform and renderer contracts behind compatibility re-exports
dataset: cargo check graph for gpui, platform crates, zzz default member
metric: Clean/incremental wall time, rebuilt crate count, dependency edges, source edits
success_threshold: No product crate source edits; no dependency cycle; platform-only edit rebuilds <= current rebuilt crate count; clean check <= baseline*1.10
result: Three-run paired clean median 19.80 s vs 19.84 s baseline (0.998x); no cycle; zero product source edits; gpui_platform downstream count remains 8
notes: Raw logs: .tmp/gpui-refactor/phase-5/exp004-recheck-{baseline,candidate}-{1,2,3}.log. Internal module seam retained.

workload: Separate Scene/atlas/renderer contract from App/Window runtime
dataset: Existing GPUI examples plus editor_render benchmark scene corpus
metric: API migration count, render equivalence, compile time, binary size
success_threshold: Compatibility facade yields 0 consumer edits; golden scene output unchanged; clean build <= baseline*1.10; binary size <= baseline*1.03
result: Zero consumer edits; 0/20,000 fallback pixels changed; clean ratio 0.998x; release-fast file ratio 1.000057x and ELF text+data+bss ratio 1.000496x
notes: Keep render_api internal: gpui_wgpu still needs GPUI text/geometry types, so a new crate would not reduce the rebuild graph and would add a second public ownership boundary.

workload: Core semantics and native adapter integration
dataset: Button, input, editor, list/tree, tabs, dialogs, status notifications on macOS/Windows/Linux
metric: Semantic snapshot, action dispatch, focus mapping, platform walkthrough
success_threshold: All named interactive controls appear with role/name/state; accessible actions mutate once; keyboard focus matches accessibility focus; VoiceOver/Narrator/Orca smoke passes
result: Core semantics, completed-frame payload, advertised actions, one-shot Click/Focus routing, keyboard focus mapping, all named component snapshots, and Linux X11/Wayland native AT-SPI registration/action pass; macOS and Windows adapters cross-compile
notes: Linux pyatspi and Orca enumeration pass. VoiceOver and Narrator runtime are NOT RUN on this Linux host; exact platform runbooks remain required. Writer state and synthetic children were intentionally omitted.

dataset: 10 representative components and editor viewport updates
metric: Nodes/views reprocessed, frame phase time, correctness assertions
success_threshold: At least 20% less phase work in targeted cases with no pixel/input/focus divergence; otherwise reject the added invalidation API
result: Without accessibility the prototype reduced component renders from 10 to 0 but left all 10 visual projections and input handlers stale; with accessibility enabled semantic rebuilding kept work at 200 vs 200, a 0% reduction
notes: Temporary notify_with and cache-policy code was removed; only phase dirty diagnostics remain. Raw logs: .tmp/gpui-refactor/phase-8/exp007-scoped-invalidation{,-accessibility}.log.

dataset: Background-to-main handoff, timers, cancellation, window teardown; 100 randomized seeds
metric: Completion time, hangs, races, teardown leaks, deterministic-test parity
success_threshold: 0 hangs/panics/leaks in 100 runs; all deterministic assertions also pass; benchmark variance CV <=10% after warmup
result: 100 seeds pass handoff, timers, cancellation, panic cleanup and teardown; zero hangs/failures; warm mean 10.686 ms and CV 2.134%
notes: TestDispatcher remains the deterministic default; ThreadedDispatcher is opt-in for benchmark/integration use.

dataset: Latin dead keys, CJK preedit, emoji, RTL, multi-cursor composition, accessibility keyboard on macOS/Linux/Windows/Web
metric: Committed text, marked range, selection, candidate bounds, undo grouping
success_threshold: All existing editor IME tests pass; platform scripts match expected UTF-16 ranges and cursor bounds; no lost/duplicated commit in 100 repetitions
result: All platform bridges now use TextInputClient; Editor IME, focus, UTF-16 and multi-cursor tests and Vim native-key bypass pass; native platform repetition scripts not run
notes: PlatformInputHandler remains only as a one-breaking-release compatibility alias; Web candidate positioning is explicitly unsupported.

workload: Remove static editor factory and relocate product prompt integration
dataset: ui_input, editor, workspace security modal, ui_prompt startup
metric: Changed public APIs, consumer edits, initialization-order failures, incremental compile time
success_threshold: No process-global factory; startup-order test passes; <=10 consumer call-site changes; editor-only change no longer recompiles generic UI components where avoidable
result: App-scoped factory; three consumers use non-panicking boundary; startup-order test passes; editor-only rebuild keeps ui, ui_input, ui_component_registry, and component_preview Fresh
notes: Raw log: .tmp/gpui-refactor/phase-7/exp010-editor-only-incremental.log. Product prompt policy lives in zzz composition.

workload: Frame and layout allocation regression gate
dataset: Warm editor render, 1,000 scroll frames, 1,000 workspace layout resizes
success_threshold: No-op/cached frame allocations <= baseline; refactor allocations and peak RSS <= baseline*1.03
result: Production Editor feature-off allocations are unchanged or lower than 567ff2f4; feature-on adds <=0.003 allocations/frame and <=0.203% bytes/frame; peak RSS is 0.996x baseline off and 1.011x candidate off when diagnostics are enabled
notes: Seven CPU-pinned release-fast processes per configuration; raw logs and summary are in .tmp/gpui-refactor/phase-1/editor-workload-*-v3-*.log and editor-workload-summary.txt.
